scope: Operational assessment of the two configured providers for recent devnet attempts; read-only, no configuration changed
observations: Both providers were healthy, reported the expected devnet genesis and retained history earlier than the original context slot.
Both returned matching finalized status and transaction metadata for the known successful basket and the known failed transaction.
Both reported the original blockhash invalid at finalized heights beyond its last valid height; both history-aware status and finalized transaction lookups returned null for the original identifier.
The two provider hosts returned different node identities. This does not establish permanent independence of every archival storage backend.
assessment: Enabling the existing flags is supportable as an explicit operator trust decision for this recent devnet test, subject to the existing per-attempt health, genesis, history coverage, finalized height, invalid blockhash, no-conflict and original-status/metadata checks. The probe does not establish arbitrary-age history completeness or a production archival guarantee.
requiredNextStep: Root decides configuration. If trust is enabled, run fresh backend reconciliation of the original attempt and require its durable safeToRetry decision before a new terms revision or new signatures. Do not release locks or replace attempts based on this report alone.
limitations: getFirstAvailableBlock reports the lowest available confirmed ledger slot; it is not an assertion that every transaction index is complete.
getTransaction null means not found at the requested commitment; null alone is not sufficient recovery evidence.
Solana public RPC is rate-limited and devnet can reset. Helius standard-RPC history documentation is broad and does not specifically promise indefinite devnet retention.
Any RPC error, coverage loss, conflicting status, or prior observed success must keep the original attempt unresolved.
